vm._note: The hypervisor of the virtual machines module. list prints one <name><TAB>running|stopped per machine and fails when the hypervisor does not answer; configure tells it about the <pool>/vm dataset. definition_template, disk_template and nic_template turn the neutral machine record into the backend's definition. Every edition gives a machine the same hardware: UEFI, virtio disks and networks in the same PCI slots, plain VGA and one serial port.
vm.list: out=$(vm list) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk 'NR>1 && NF {{ print $1 "\t" (/Running/ ? "running" : "stopped") }}'
vm.definition_template:
loader="uefi"
uuid="{uuid}"
cpu={cpus}
memory={memory_mb}M
graphics="yes"
graphics_listen="127.0.0.1"
xhci_mouse="yes"
{disks}{nics}
vm.bridge_ensure: vm switch list | awk '{{print $1}}' | grep -qx {bridge} || vm switch create -t manual -b {bridge} {bridge}
